blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-bad-14"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
timeout = "30m"
network = "none"

[sandbox]
timezone = "America/New_York"
clock = { start = 2026-03-14T09:00:00-07:00, enforce = "vm" }

diagnostics.message: [sandbox] clock start 2026-03-14 09:00:00-07:00 is at -07:00, but America/New_York is at -04:00 at that instant, so the agent would see 12:00; write start = "2026-03-14T12:00:00-04:00", or the time you meant with -04:00
